owner: Original Powerhouse SEO Order Engine / BG169
root_cause: Equal route counts were accepted even when the expected and observed sitemap route sets differed; declared locale targets lacked reciprocal verification; broader SEO methods had no explicit evidence status. Independent live replay also exposed first-robots-meta-only false negatives in both sitemap generation and browser collection.
fix: Require exact unique expected/observed route-set equality
Verify declared hreflang self and reciprocal links where observed
Expose source-grounded 12-method coverage; unmeasured external results stay unmeasured
Collect every applicable robots meta and navigation X-Robots-Tag; final sitemap generator excludes restrictive noindex/none even if an earlier tag says index.
prevention: No health score on missing, unexpected or duplicate routes
No full SEO method pass based on DOM only
Never override restrictive robots directives; re-test conflicting tags, agent-specific directives and response headers against final output.
Before terminal delivery run every existing test that reads a changed browser source; preserve verified replacement navigation response, bounded retry, original visibility and CLS failure gates.
Distinguish exact verified nonindexed functional destinations from missing SEO canonicals. Preserve restrictive login robots tags and all invalid-link checks; do not allow arbitrary /en/ routes.
